title: teamcall: a company's people from chat to a terminal agent in 30 days, measured
description: teamcall is a Claude Code plugin that moves a company's people from the chat window to a terminal agent and measures the move. It writes a pilot charter that grows from 5 people to 30-50 through champions, with a one-page set-up for IT; a 20-minute fast path per person and a 5-hour champion path; turns a task done in the app into one command in the terminal; keeps a transition journal; reports six measurements (time, quality, coverage, repeatability, new capability, what a person checks) and the minutes of human help per first working result, without names; writes a one-page decision to scale, fix and repeat, or stop; lists which seat already pays for which terminal agent, each row with its source page and day; and sends one short card a day in Telegram or WhatsApp from the company's own bot, teaching how to lead an agent and approve its steps, with the answers (done, show me, skip) counted into the report without names. It buys nothing. Python standard library only; only the daily cards talk to the network, and only to the Telegram Bot API and the WhatsApp Cloud API.
